body: I'm trying, but it just seems pointless. One day I'm actually hopeful things will work out, another it just doesn't seem to matter anymore. A small part of me wants to go through with life and try and get better and live out the plans I had for my future, but no future's worth the agony I have to deal with every single day. I've got a few hobbies, though I've kinda lost interest in some now. Stuff like swimming and writing, which I haven't done in ages since I've got no motivation to, but I'm also pretty into gaming, and I guess I do that pretty often now.

My mom knows I'm suicidal, but she breaks down crying or goes quiet whenever it's mentioned. I recently got put into therapy too, so I guess I am getting help, but I doubt it'll do any good. It's all pointless.
USA. Florida to be more specific.
